name: The Portman Travel Group Limited
note: UK private limited company (Companies House no. 08831424, incorporated 3 January 2014, previously Mawasem Travel and Tourism Limited until July 2017). Its PSC register files an active statement, notified 1 January 2018, that there is no registrable person or registrable relevant legal entity in relation to the company; the last ceased PSC (Dr Nasser Aqeel Al Tayyar, Saudi; >25-50% of shares) ceased on 1 January 2018, before the group took its present form in the Clarity-Portman combination.
